tariff_name: TNPDCL LT Tariff I-A (Domestic) - approved tariff before Government of Tamil Nadu subsidy

source.name: Tamil Nadu Electricity Regulatory Commission (TNERC)
source.document: TNERC Suo-motu Order No. 6 of 2025 dated 30-06-2025, Determination of Tariff for Distribution for FY 2025-26 (TNPDCL Tariff Order, 2025), effective from 01-07-2025
source.table: 3.2.2 Low Tension Tariff I-A: (Domestic, Multi-tenements, Old age homes, Handlooms) - For FY 2025-26
source.excerpt: From 0 to 200 units per month or 0-400 units for two months: 495; 201 to 250 units (401 to 500 for two months): 665; 251 to 300: 880; 301 to 400: 995; 401 to 500: 1105; 501 units and above: 1215 (energy charges in paise/kWh). Fixed Charges (Rupees per kW per month): Nil. Note: '*To be partly subsidised by the Government'.

verification_notes: Cross-checked against (1) TNPDCL's own tariff page https://www.tnpdcl.org/en/tnpdcl/billing-services/schedules-tariff/ (last updated 8 Sept 2026), which links this same order as the tariff order; the DISCOM's copy is byte-identical to the TNERC copy (same SHA-256). (2) TNERC Order No. 4 of 2026 dated 27-04-2026 (Provisional Tariff Subsidy Order for FY 2026-27), pages 7-9, restating the approved domestic energy charges with effect from 01-07-2025 and recording that the Government has committed to 'No tariff hike to the Domestic consumers (LT IA)'. Currentness: the order says FY 2026-27 tariff undergoes an inflation-based adjustment from 01 July 2026, but no revised order was published on TNERC's tariff-orders page as of 2026-09-19 and TNPDCL still lists this order; re-verify if TNERC publishes one. IMPORTANT: these are the APPROVED tariff rates. The Government of Tamil Nadu pays a per-unit subsidy under TNERC Order No. 4 of 2026 (for example, the first 100 units per two months are free to domestic consumers), so a household's actual bill is lower than this estimate. The subsidy is not modelled. Electricity duty/tax is levied in addition 'in accordance with the Government of Tamil Nadu stipulations' (Order 6 of 2025, clause 3.2.1(m)) and is not included.
